### Geographic Coverage

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(tigris)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Load membership data
memberships_map <- read_csv(
  "Data_Files/constituents_w_memberships.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Select and clean ZIP-code data
constituent_locations <- memberships_map %>%
  select(`Constituent ID`, `Address ZIP`) %>%
  mutate(
    `Address ZIP` = as.character(`Address ZIP`),
    `Address ZIP` = str_extract(`Address ZIP`, "\\d{5}")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Address ZIP`))

# Count unique constituents by ZIP code
zip_counts <- constituent_locations %>%
  group_by(`Address ZIP`) %>%
  summarise(
    `Constituent Count` = n_distinct(`Constituent ID`),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Constituent Count`))

head(zip_counts)
```

### Geographic Summary

```{r}
# Total number of constituents
total_constituents <- memberships_map %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(`Constituent ID`)
  ) %>%
  pull(n)

# Constituents with valid ZIP codes
constituents_with_zip <- constituent_locations %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(`Constituent ID`)
  ) %>%
  pull(n)

# Number of unique ZIP codes
unique_zip_codes <- n_distinct(
  constituent_locations$`Address ZIP`
)

# ZIP-code coverage
zip_coverage <- (
  constituents_with_zip / total_constituents
) * 100

cat(
  "Total constituents:",
  format(total_constituents, big.mark = ","),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Constituents with ZIP codes:",
  format(constituents_with_zip, big.mark = ","),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "ZIP coverage:",
  round(zip_coverage, 1),
  "%\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique ZIP codes:",
  format(unique_zip_codes, big.mark = ","),
  "\n"
)
```

### Utah Constituent Map

```{r}
# Download 2020 U.S. ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
us_zctas <- zctas(
  year = 2020,
  cb = TRUE
)

# Download Utah state boundary
utah_boundary <- states(
  cb = TRUE,
  year = 2020
) %>%
  filter(STUSPS == "UT")

# Make sure both layers use the same coordinate system
utah_boundary <- st_transform(
  utah_boundary,
  st_crs(us_zctas)
)

# Identify ZCTAs that intersect Utah
utah_zctas <- us_zctas[
  lengths(
    st_intersects(
      us_zctas,
      utah_boundary
    )
  ) > 0,
]

cat(
  "Utah ZIP Code Tabulation Areas:",
  nrow(utah_zctas),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Merge constituent counts with Utah ZIP boundaries
utah_constituent_map <- utah_zctas %>%
  left_join(
    zip_counts,
    by = c("ZCTA5CE20" = "Address ZIP")
  )

# Keep ZIP codes containing constituents
matched_utah_zips <- utah_constituent_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Constituent Count`))

# Calculate number of constituents represented
utah_constituents <- sum(
  matched_utah_zips$`Constituent Count`,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat(
  "Utah ZIP codes with constituents:",
  nrow(matched_utah_zips),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Utah constituents represented on map:",
  format(
    utah_constituents,
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Percent of all constituents represented in Utah:",
  round(
    utah_constituents / total_constituents * 100,
    1
  ),
  "%\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Plot Utah constituent distribution
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = utah_constituent_map,
    aes(fill = `Constituent Count`),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightblue",
    high = "darkblue",
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "Constituent Count"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = utah_boundary,
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Geographic Distribution of PBS Utah Constituents",
    subtitle = "Unique constituents by ZIP Code"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## Passport Viewing Data

### Load Data

```{r}
# Load Passport viewing data
passport <- read_csv(
  "Data_Files/passport_viewing_data.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

### Data Overview

```{r}
cat(
  "Viewing records:",
  format(nrow(passport), big.mark = ","),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique Passport accounts:",
  format(
    n_distinct(passport$UID),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique constituents:",
  format(
    n_distinct(passport$`Constituent.ID`),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Unique series:",
  format(
    n_distinct(passport$`Content.Channel`),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

### Clean Data

```{r}
# Rename Passport title columns
passport <- passport %>%
  rename(
    Series_Title = `Content.Channel`,
    Episode_Title = Title
  )
```

### Series Reach and Viewing

```{r}
# Calculate total number of unique Passport accounts
total_accounts <- n_distinct(passport$UID)

# Aggregate viewing activity by series
show_summary <- passport %>%
  group_by(Series_Title) %>%
  summarise(
    Reach = n_distinct(UID),
    total_watch_time_seconds = sum(
      `Time.Watched`,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    `Avg. Completion (%)` = mean(
      `Percent.Watched`,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Reach (%)` = round(
      Reach / total_accounts * 100,
      2
    ),
    `Watch Time (Hrs)` = round(
      total_watch_time_seconds / 3600,
      2
    ),
    `Avg. Completion (%)` = round(
      `Avg. Completion (%)`,
      2
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Series_Title,
    Reach,
    `Reach (%)`,
    `Watch Time (Hrs)`,
    `Avg. Completion (%)`
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Reach),
    desc(`Watch Time (Hrs)`)
  )
```

### Series Summary

```{r}
# Display full series summary
show_summary
```
